quote: Guarantor hereby agrees that upon, and from and after, the occurrence of any one or more of the Springing Events (defined below) (the date of such occurrence, the "Springing Event Trigger Date"), Guarantor absolutely, unconditionally and irrevocably guarantees, as a primary obligor and not merely as a surety: (i) the full and prompt payment of all Base Rent, Additional Rent and all other sums and charges of every type and nature payable by SPV Tenant under the SPV Lease
